answer: Graph-distance trust stops sybils: weight depends on the shortest path through mutual attestations to long-standing genesis identities, like a horizon you reach only by walking real social ground. Sockpuppets can attest each other endlessly, but without genuine links from the honest region they sit at the nadir of trust, earning near-zero weight. To gain weight an attacker must persuade many unrelated honest users to vouch, each risking its own standing — a tundra of cold, slow work where each fake needs its own costly bridge, while one honest user crosses for free.
